Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
A partner broker holding funds and executing orders.
Withdrawals processed in under a day, per the page.
No prior trading experience required.
whatWeChecked: The demo claim: practice account confirmed in the signup flow.
The payout promise: within-a-day wording without processing detail.
The broker relationship: which partner desk executes orders.
The asset list: how many pairs are actually offered.
The registration flow: what personal details the form collects.
The risk disclosure: where the capital-at-risk wording sits.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Open the signup page, enter your information and confirm the account by email.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Add US$200 to the account through the payment options shown at checkout.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set your preferences, select automatic or manual execution, and run the practice account first.

pros: No platform fees on top of spreads.
redFlags: Ownership details missing from the public pages.
The demo promised in the pitch but buried in the flow.
A score and a community mood wearing the same number.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.
The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$200 minimum.

faqs.q: Where is Fonte Bitanza Ai restricted?
faqs.a: The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

bottomLine: Fonte Bitanza Ai does what it says mechanically - signals, two modes, a broker partner. The open questions are pricing clarity and verification, both solvable by reading before funding.
We rate it 4.5 with conditions: the platform is usable, the published claims are not all verifiable, and the US$200 minimum is the right size for testing either.
